title: 第201章 好大壮，给姐吧~
slug: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“做什么都可以吗？”李大壮双眸火热的盯着那两座傲人圆润问，他忽然很想亵玩一番，手感肯定很好……

“嗯~”程露思羞涩的点了点头，感受着到李大壮直白的眼光，程露思只觉得浑身都躁得慌，穿着肉色丝袜的双腿也开始发软，心中升起一股难耐的期待。

她之前只在自己闺房里，浅尝似的体验了一次李大壮那双带着薄茧的粗糙大手，就再也忘不掉了，夜夜都想，这会儿更想……

她渴望李大壮能对自己柔软的胸脯做些什么，或者是更深入的地方……

李大壮咽了咽口水，忽然想到了柳燕，顿时有些歇火了：“那个，其实我也没啥想做的！”

“你说谎！”程露思有些着急，当场拆穿了李大壮：“你明明一直盯着我这儿了，你不想要吗？”

“咳咳，露思姐别闹，你这么性感漂亮，是个男人都想要的，但我已经有女朋友了，我跟柳姐关系特殊，你跟柳姐又是闺蜜，咱俩这样不合适。”李大壮解释道。

程露思却难以置信的瞪大了眸子：“你这话什么意思？你的女朋友，不是柳柳！？”

“嗯！”李大壮如实道：“我跟柳姐，柳姐算是我的红颜吧。”

程露思更震惊了：“柳柳这么傲气的人，竟然愿意做别人的红颜，不过我算是明白她为什么会给我发那种信息了！”

“毕竟是你是有正牌女友的，我们就算都跟你在一起了，也不会形成什么竞争关系，说不定还能强强联手，跟你的关系更加亲密！”

程露思心里有种说不出来的感觉，本以为自己只是需要跟闺蜜分享男人，没想到连闺蜜都不是正牌女友，但这么一来，对柳燕的愧疚感少了许多，也更能放得开了！

既然都是红颜，那就没什么好顾忌的！

“柳姐给你发啥信息了？”李大壮好奇的问。

程露思狡黠的眨了眨眼睛，故作神秘的说：“你猜？”

"Can I do anything?" Li Dazhuang asked, staring at the two proud and round figures with burning eyes. He suddenly wanted to play with it, it must feel good...

"Hmm~" Cheng Lusi nodded shyly. Feeling Li Dazhuang's straightforward eyes, Cheng Lusi felt her whole body agitated. Her legs wearing flesh-colored stockings began to weaken, and an unbearable expectation arose in her heart.

She had only had a taste of Li Dazhuang's calloused rough hands in her boudoir before, and she could never forget them. She thought about them every night, and even more so now...

She longed for what Li Dazhuang could do to her soft breasts, or go deeper...

Li Dazhuang swallowed, and suddenly thought of Liu Yan, and suddenly became a little relieved: "Well, actually, there is nothing I want to do!"

"You lied!" Cheng Lusi was a little anxious and exposed Li Dazhuang on the spot: "You have been staring at me, don't you want it?"

"Ahem, sister Lucy, don't make trouble. You are so sexy and beautiful that every man wants you. But I already have a girlfriend. I have a special relationship with Sister Liu. You and Sister Liu are best friends. This is not appropriate for us." Li Dazhuang explained.

Cheng Lusi's eyes widened in disbelief: "What do you mean by that? Your girlfriend is not Liu Liu!?"

"Yeah!" Li Dazhuang said truthfully: "Sister Liu and I, Sister Liu is my beauty."

Cheng Lusi was even more shocked: "Liu Liu, such an arrogant person, is willing to be someone else's beauty, but I finally understand why she would send me that kind of message!"

"After all, you have a real girlfriend. Even if we are together with you, we will not form any competitive relationship. Maybe we can join forces and have a closer relationship with you!"

Cheng Lusi had an indescribable feeling in her heart. She thought she just needed to share her man with her best friend, but she didn't expect that even her best friend was not her real girlfriend. But this way, she felt much less guilty about Liu Yan, and she was more able to let go!

Since they are all beauties, there is nothing to worry about!

"What message did Sister Liu send you?" Li Dazhuang asked curiously.

Cheng Lusi blinked slyly and said mysteriously, "What do you think?"
